summary_en: HISAKA WORKS authorized acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares (3.80% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 2,000 million yen via open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 through March 31, 2027 to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, HISAKA WORKS' Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares pursuant to Article 165(3) of the Companies Act (applied with modifications from Article 156). The authorization permits the company to acquire up to 1,000,000 shares of its common stock, representing 3.80% of outstanding shares (26,333,573 shares as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum total expenditure of 2,000 million yen. Acquisitions will be conducted via open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 16, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The stated purpose of the buyback is to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. This authorization provides the company with discretionary capacity to execute its capital strategy over the six-month period.
